note: Rewritten from Roonwal & Chhotani 1989; original in English; the OCR of the archive.org scan is mostly clear, and the original forms "apilose" and "a liiile" are OCR corruptions transcribed by context; the measurements in mm are kept verbatim (ranges given with —).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to straw coloured; antennae yellow to pale yellow; labrum straw coloured; base of the mandibles deep straw and the rest dark brown; pronotum, tibiae, tarsi and dorsal abdomen yellow; femora and sternites yellowish white. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length with wings about 10.5—11.5 mm, without wings about 6.2—7.5 mm. Head capsule almost rectangular, covered with short hairs; length to the mandibular base 1.05—1.20 mm, nearly equal to the maximum width including the eyes 1.16—1.20 mm; convex in the middle in side view; anterior part of the frons gently sloping, without a median depression; Y suture absent. Compound eyes black, large, nearly circular, maximum diameter including the eye ring 0.4—0.5 mm, close against the antennae, the minimum distance between eye and antenna 0.013—0.025 mm; ocelli white, small (maximum diameter 0.20—0.22 mm), oval, translucent, broadly touching the eye ring. Antennae 15—17-segmented; with 15—16 segments segment 3 is longer than segment 2, with 17 segments segment 3 and segment 2 are nearly equal. Anteclypeus trapezoidal, white, hairless; postclypeus almost rectangular, hairy, darker than the frons. Anterior part of the labrum sparsely hairy; almost square hexagonal, the middle of the sides sharply projecting, narrowing towards the flattened broad margins. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum almost rectangular, slightly wider than the head, length 0.80—0.85 mm and width 1.27—1.45 mm; anterior margin weakly concave, without a median notch; posterior margin nearly straight with a weak median incurving. Legs short and slender, tibial spurs 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented; no arolium. Wings white, without tubercles and without hairs. Forewing: venation as in beesoni, but the subcosta shorter, meeting the marginal vein at about 1/6 of the wing membrane; radius joining the marginal vein before the middle; radial sector with 6—8 branches reaching the anterior margin; media generally arising from the cubitus and lying outside the wing scale (occasionally within the scale); cubitus with 10—13 branches reaching the posterior margin. Hind wing: venation as in beesoni, but the radial sector with 5—6 branches reaching the anterior margin beyond the middle, and the cubitus with 15—18 branches reaching the posterior margin. Abdomen elongate, hairy; cerci short, 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Front of the head reddish brown, posterior part yellowish brown; base of the antennae brown, apex pale yellow; mandibles black with a reddish brown base; pronotum pale brown to brown; legs paler; abdomen white. Head and body moderately hairy. Body length about 7.4—8.5 mm. Head capsule almost rectangular, distinctly longer than wide, length to the mandibular base 2.0—2.28 mm, width 1.55—1.60 mm; sides almost parallel; anterior part of the frons gently sloping, the median depression extending backwards from the frons to the middle of the head; Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes small, oval, black, long diameter 0.20—0.22 mm, slightly raised above the head surface, about their long diameter from the antennae (0.18—0.20 mm). No ocelli. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 long, club-shaped, strongly chitinised; antennal carinae well developed, projecting and strongly sclerotised. Anteclypeus trapezoidal, hairless, translucent; postclypeus almost rectangular, with 2 pairs of hairs anteriorly, its boundary with the frons indistinct. Labrum short, semicircular, slightly projecting in the middle in front, apex and body with a few hairs. Mandibles 1.25—1.30 mm long, stout, the outer margin raised into a nodular swelling at the base, about 2/3 of the head length (to the mandibular base); left mandible with 5 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum club-shaped, 1.55—1.70 mm long; the broad anterior part about half the total length, weakly to moderately bilobed, narrowing posteriorly into a waist about half the maximum width; broad part 0.60 mm wide, waist 0.25—0.30 mm. Pronotum almost rectangular, wider than long and slightly wider than the head, width 1.60—1.75 mm, length 1.10 mm; anterior margin strongly angular or gradually incurved; anterior lateral corners sharp, narrower than the posterior corners; posterior margin nearly straight to nearly convex. Legs short, slender and hairy; femora moderately swollen; tibial spurs 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate; each tergite with 2 rows of hairs; cerci short, 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head pale straw; body and legs white tinged with yellow. Head and body moderately hairy. Body length about 6.0—7.5 mm. Head capsule almost circular, length to the mandibular base 1.20 mm, width 1.30—1.40 mm; anterior part of the frons gently sloping, with a shallow median depression. Compound eyes degenerate, small, black, flush with the head surface. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 nearly equal to or longer than segment 2, square with rounded sides. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum almost rectangular, broadly concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Talawila, Sri Lanka (near Puttalam, the type locality); Barkuda Island, Chilka Lake, Orissa, India. The holotype (lectotype, designated by Roonwal & Sen-Sarma 1960) is a soldier, deposited in the Department of Entomology, Zoological Institute, University of Lund, Sweden. The distinction from beesoni is given in the key to the Indian fauna of the genus: alate head width 1.16—1.20 mm and pronotum width 1.27—1.45 mm (beesoni 1.36—1.51 and 1.55—1.68); soldier pronotum width 1.60—1.75 mm with narrow rounded anterior lateral corners, and the broad anterior part of the postmentum about 1/2 of the total length and distinctly bilobed (beesoni pronotum width 1.70—2.29 mm, postmentum broad part about 2/3).
